definitions.gloss: sociable; good at keeping company; willing to go along with others
definitions.explanation: Describes someone who readily joins social activities, accepts invitations, and is easy to spend time with. Highly valued in Japanese workplace and social culture.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{付|つ}き{合|あ}いがいい⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
⟦{飲|の}み→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{誘|さそ}う→誘う：01947_sasou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{来|く}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦くれて→くれる：00724_kureru⟧、{付|つ}き{合|あ}いがいい。
examples.english: He always comes when invited for drinks — he's good company.

examples.japanese: {付|つ}き{合|あ}いがいい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧にした⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: Being sociable is fine, but you should also value your own time.

notes:
USAGE:
A compliment in Japanese social culture, where willingness to join group activities (especially after-work drinking) is valued. The opposite is ⟦{付|つ}き{合|あ}い→付き合い：03520_tsukiai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (unsociable, reluctant to join). The noun ⟦{付|つ}き{合|あ}い→付き合い：03520_tsukiai⟧ alone means "social relations" or "company."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {付|つ}き{合|あ}いがいい⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a sociable person)
- ⟦{付|つ}き{合|あ}い→付き合い：03520_tsukiai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (unsociable; a poor sport about joining in)
- ⟦{付|つ}き{合|あ}い→付き合い：03520_tsukiai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧ (to drink to be sociable)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japanese workplace culture, ⟦{付|つ}き{合|あ}い→付き合い：03520_tsukiai⟧ (social obligation/keeping company) is an important concept. Being {付|つ}き{合|あ}いがいい helps build relationships, while being ⟦{付|つ}き{合|あ}い→付き合い：03520_tsukiai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ can be seen as standoffish.
